label: PHYSICAL_2: PHYSICAL_2 in Papineau's indirect sense: what can be specified without appeal to…
definition: Physical in Papineau's indirect sense: what can be specified without appeal to whichever special vocabularies (mental, biological, ...) are at issue; with the mental as the special category, physical means nonmental (pp.12-13). Lean: the parameter `Physical` of CompletenessOfPhysicsReading, over occurrences. It is not Aristotle's respect of physical motion (DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT) and not 'composed of matter and form' (DISAMB-PHYSICAL).
